description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Swaps a head from a supplied image onto a supplied body image. Costs 10 credits; returns a project id for wait_for_image_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

assets.description: Provide the body and head images for head swap

body_file_path.description:
Image that receives the swapped head. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

head_file_path.description:
Image of the head to place on the body. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.
